title: Convolution filter: FLA parsed but no model type or SWF encoder
description: Flash 8 ConvolutionFilter (type 5) is decoded from FLA binary and silently discarded (return null in flash8-binary.ts:1269). No model type, no UI, no SWF encoder. SWF spec defines FilterID=5 with a full matrix encoding. Full end-to-end gap: FLA import → model → SWF emit → Ruffle render.
